title: Propala hramota
writer: Nikolay Gogol, Ivan Drach, Oleksa Storozhenko
actors: Ivan Mikolaychuk, Lidiya Belozyorova, Fyodor Strigun
plot: A Soviet musical-tragicomedy film by Dovzhenko Film Studios in Kyiv. The movie is considered a pearl of Soviet and Ukrainian cinema. The film is based on the novella by Nikolay Gogol.
